name: Azure DDoS Protection
short_description: Azure DDoS Protection is an Azure service that defends Azure resources against distributed denial-of-service attacks at the network layer, complementing application-layer protection such as Azure Web Application Firewall.

evidence.quote: Azure DDoS protection handles the big network layer floods, while the firewall handles application layer attacks like HTTP floods.
Azure Deedos protection adds intelligence and visibility on top of that free baseline.
